description: Resolve a country to the UN M49 code the trade tools require, and list the HS headings this catalog maps. FREE. Call this BEFORE trade.flow, trade.partners or trade.ranking: those take a reporter code and there is no other way to discover one. Accepts ISO3, ISO2, a numeric M49 or an exact country name. Historical entities are excluded by default — twelve ISO3 codes resolve to more than one UN Comtrade entry and the expired one is never preferred, so IND gives India rather than pre-1974 India.

country.description: ISO3, ISO2, numeric M49 or exact name to resolve. Omit to list HS headings only.

name: trade.codes

resolved.description: The matched country, when one was asked for
